decisions.reason: Although the particle-therapy water phantom remains a niche product with uncertain adoption, organisational slack still allows its retention as a strategic extension unless a clear persistent shortfall triggers problemistic search.
This small-volume ionization chamber fits the core dosimetry portfolio and its results have not shown a shortfall below aspiration that would justify reallocating slack resources.
The second small-volume chamber is complementary within the same segment and is carried while its still-uncertain performance is judged against comparable products and past results.
The standard clinical ionization chamber line is central to the firm's established calibration business and is judged as meeting or exceeding aspiration, making a drop very unlikely.
The relative dosimetry chamber lies within the firm's core expertise and shows no clear shortfall that would trigger problemistic search or resource reallocation.
The thimble ionization chamber supports mainstream QA workflows and, given organisational slack, is retained while market acceptance continues to develop.
